gaps.title: Real execution span boundaries
gaps.current: Main has request trace IDs and run/tool timings. The unfinished draft creates stage-grouped spans after the answer, explicitly not a wall-clock timeline.
gaps.missing: Capture started/ended/failed spans at actual retrieval, tool and provider boundaries with sequence, parent/span ID, request ID and terminal response evidence.
gaps.acceptance: An injected provider error leaves ordered, timed evidence up to failure; every executed tool and retry links to the same turn.

gaps.title: Durable checkpoints and idempotent support actions
gaps.current: The answer/ticket can be produced before AgentConversationService saves its JSON turn.
gaps.missing: Persist request intent before side effects, stable tool invocation/idempotency key, and explicit unknown-outcome recovery. Keep it inside the same conversation JSON, not a new chat table.
gaps.acceptance: Kill execution before/after ticket creation and retry: never create duplicate cases, lose evidence or blindly replay an uncertain action.

gaps.title: Separate business durability from telemetry failure

gaps.missing: Different failure policy for mandatory state checkpoints and noncritical telemetry; report actual business outcome, telemetry loss counter and bounded backpressure.
gaps.acceptance: Unavailable logging cannot imply a completed ticket/payment failed; mandatory checkpoint failure blocks a new side effect before dispatch.
